comments.author: cody-fifth-door
comments.body:
You can try the demo here: [https://play.fifthdoor.com/play/sandcaster?referrer=reddit](https://play.fifthdoor.com/play/sandcaster?referrer=reddit)

Featuring: Online multiplayer, destructible terrain, 4 classes, optional voice casting.

It's pretty fun! the only thing is the classes need a bit of work to get the balance/feel of the game right.

comments.author: kenttk421
comments.body: I gave it a quick try and It's very fast pasted for a new players and hard to keep track of what is happening. The bot seems to kill itself most of the time. Cool concept. I didn't get to far but is there a level or power up system. That was the appeal Noita has for me. Just need to find one more thing to really boost my power up.

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: Oh man this is really cool. I guess I never played liero or noita but I really like how the spells interact with the terrain and the concept of drafting a build.

replies.author: cody-fifth-door
replies.body:
Right?

There is a third game that was a big inspiration called Arcanists. It's been gone for a while now but I loved that game and wanted to recreate it in spirit. It was exactly this but turn based. 

I always loved the build system in the game. Every school felt unique and overpowered in it's own way. Or it did back them, looking back now I think only one or two schools were actually any good. Still! Lots of fun!
